transcript.text: hoover washer drier showing EO3 wont drain, ive done the filter its clean. H3DS4965DACE. pump just buzzes. do i need a new pump??

[Heading: Blocked or jammed drain pump]
A buzzing sound usually means electricity is reaching the pump, but it can't turn because something is blocking it. Before you buy a new pump, please do this quick check: switch off and unplug the machine first. With the filter removed, look inside the sump hole with a torch and try to spin the plastic impeller vanes gently with your finger. If it feels stiff or won't turn at all because something is caught in it, that's likely the cause (and removing the object might fix it). If it spins freely but still buzzes and doesn't pump water when you run a drain cycle, then the pump motor has likely failed and needs replacing.
did that, impeller spins completely freely, no resistance at all, feels like its not connected to anything. torch shows one fin looks snapped. so new pump yeah?

[Heading: Failed drain pump (broken impeller)]
Yes, the pump needs replacing.

claimsRejected.claim: The EO3 code confirms a drain fault, and the fact that you've already cleaned the filter but the pump still buzzes strongly suggests the impeller inside the pump is jammed by debris (like a coin or button) or the pump motor itself has failed.

candidates.cause: Jammed or blocked drain pump impeller
